create_lasr_tokenizer: create a LasrTokenizer instance from a SentencePiece vocab file with custom extra_ids
build_lasr_tokenizer_with_sentinels: build a LasrTokenizer with extra sentinel tokens for sequence-to-sequence tasks
get_sentinel_tokens: get the list of sentinel token strings from a LasrTokenizer's additional_special_tokens
get_sentinel_token_ids: get the token IDs corresponding to sentinel tokens in a LasrTokenizer
decode_lasr_tokens: decode a list of LasrTokenizer token IDs into a text string filtering pad tokens
